verdict.rationale: The README documents terminal chat, but only as one-shot prompts (gh-8, with --max-new and --show-thinking), plus an OpenAI-compatible `edge0 serve` endpoint queried via curl and a macOS local CLI. None of this shows a persistent multi-turn interactive session. Missing for 10: an interactive REPL/chat mode with conversation history, documented chat command syntax, independent or hands-on corroboration.
